q1.explanationZh: frequent 的名词形式是 frequency“频率；频繁”，注意结尾 -ency。

q2.explanationZh: frequent 形容词“频繁的”，加 -ly 变成副词 frequently。

q3.explanationZh: frequent 加 -ly 构成副词 frequently“频繁地；经常地”。

q4.explanationZh: fresh 形容词“新鲜的”，fresh air“新鲜空气”。

q5.explanationZh: freshman“一年级新生”，复数和 man → men 一样，变成 freshmen。

q6.explanationZh: friction 名词“摩擦；分歧”，trade frictions“贸易摩擦”。

q7.explanationZh: fridge 是 refrigerator 的简称，意思是“冰箱”，注意结尾 -dge。

q8.explanationZh: friend“朋友”，注意 i 在 e 前面：f-r-i-e-n-d。

q9.explanationZh: friend 加 -ly 构成形容词 friendly“友好的”，be friendly to sb.“对某人友好”。

q10.explanationZh: friend 加后缀 -ship（表示关系、状态）构成名词 friendship“友谊”。

q11.explanationZh: fright（惊吓）加 -en 构成动词 frighten“使惊恐”。

q12.explanationZh: -ed 形容词 frightened 表示人自己“感到害怕的”；frightening 是“令人害怕的”。

q14.explanationZh: from 介词“从……；从……来”，graduate from“从……毕业”。

q15.explanationZh: front 名词“前面；前线”，in front of“在……前面”。

q16.explanationZh: front（前面）+ -ier 构成 frontier“边界；边境”。

q17.explanationZh: frost 名词“霜；霜冻”，注意不要和 frozen“冰冻的”混淆。

q18.explanationZh: frozen 是 freeze 的过去分词，作形容词“冰冻的”，frozen food“冷冻食品”。

q19.explanationZh: fruit 名词“水果；成果”，注意中间是 ui。

q20.explanationZh: frustrate 动词“挫败；使灰心”，名词是 frustration。

q21.explanationZh: fry 作动词“油煎，油炸”，作名词“油煎食品”；过去式是 fried，复数 fries 指“炸薯条”。

q22.explanationZh: fuel 名词“燃料”，作动词“给……加燃料；激起”。

q23.explanationZh: fulfil 是英式拼写，fulfill 是美式拼写，两种都对，意思是“履行；实现”。

q24.explanationZh: full 形容词“满的；饱的”，be full of“充满”。

q25.explanationZh: fun 名词“乐趣”，是不可数名词，have fun“玩得高兴”。

q26.explanationZh: function 作名词“功能”，作动词“运转；起作用”。

q27.explanationZh: fund 名词“基金；资金”，常用复数 funds。

q28.explanationZh: fundamental 形容词“基本的；根本的”，注意拼写 fund-a-ment-al。

q29.explanationZh: funeral 名词“葬礼”，注意拼写 fun-er-al。

q30.explanationZh: fun 双写 n 再加 -y 构成形容词 funny“滑稽的；好笑的”。

q31.explanationZh: fur 名词“（动物的）软毛；毛皮”。

q32.explanationZh: furnish 动词“为（房间）配备家具”，a furnished flat“带家具的公寓”。

q33.explanationZh: furniture 是家具的总称，不可数，“一件家具”说 a piece of furniture。

q34.explanationZh: further 可作形容词、副词“进一步的（地）”，也可作动词“促进”。

q35.explanationZh: further + more = furthermore“而且；此外”，用来补充说明。

q36.explanationZh: future 名词“将来”，也可作形容词“将来的”，in the future“将来”。

q37.explanationZh: gain 作动词“获得；增加”，作名词“获得；收益”，gain weight“体重增加”。

q38.explanationZh: gallery 名词“画廊；美术馆”，注意双写 l。

q39.explanationZh: make friends (with sb.)“（与某人）交朋友”，friends 一定用复数。

q40.explanationZh: frighten sb. into doing sth.“吓唬某人去做某事”，into 后接动名词。

accept: frighten sb. out of doing sth.
frighten sb out of doing sth

q41.explanationZh: frighten sb. out of doing sth.“吓得某人不敢做某事”，out of 表示“不再做”。

q42.explanationZh: from then on“从那时起”；from now on 是“从现在开始”。

q43.explanationZh: in front of 除了“在……前面”，还可以表示“当着……的面”。

q44.explanationZh: in front of 指在某物外部的前面，不带 the。

q45.explanationZh: in the front of 指在某物内部的前部，比如车里的前排，要加 the。

q46.explanationZh: be full of“充满”，介词用 of。

q47.explanationZh: have fun“玩得高兴”，fun 是不可数名词，前面不加 a。

q48.explanationZh: for fun“为了好玩；闹着玩儿地”。

q49.explanationZh: make fun of sb.“取笑某人；开某人的玩笑”。

accept: It is great fun doing/to do sth. ...
It is great fun doing/to do sth.
It is great fun doing/to do sth
It is great fun doing sth.
It is great fun to do sth.
It is great fun to do
It's great fun to do sth.

q50.explanationZh: It is great fun doing/to do sth.“做某事很好玩”，fun 是名词，前面用 great 修饰。

accept: It is no fun doing sth.
It is not any fun doing ...
It is not any fun doing
It is no fun/not any fun doing ...

q51.explanationZh: It is no fun / not any fun doing ...“做……没意思”，fun 是名词，否定用 no 或 not any。

q52.explanationZh: in the future“在将来”；in future（不带 the）是“今后，从今以后”。

q53.explanationZh: 谚语“不劳无获”：No pains, no gains.（答案书的写法），手册写作 No pain, no gain.，两种都对。

q54.explanationZh: 生物课上解剖的动物是“青蛙”，a 后用单数 frog。

q55.explanationZh: 开窗是让“新鲜的”空气进来，fresh air。

q56.explanationZh: be 后用形容词，人“感到害怕”用 frightened。

q57.explanationZh: 不新鲜的是“冷冻”食品，frozen food。

q58.explanationZh: aircraft 单复数同形，这里作复数主语，谓语用原形 fly。练习册原印 Aircrafts（答案书答案为 fuel），经人工复核（GitHub #136）更正为 Aircraft，答案改为 fly。

q59.explanationZh: a piece of furniture“一件家具”，furniture 不可数，不加 s。

q60.explanationZh: be friendly to sb.“对某人友好”，用形容词 friendly。

q61.explanationZh: graduate from“从……毕业”，介词用 from。

q62.explanationZh: even further“更进一步地”，修饰动词 worsen。

q63.explanationZh: some of the 后接可数名词复数，手机的“功能”用 functions。

q64.sampleAnswer: Sleep position matters when it comes to heart and brain health, so it is advisable to choose a position where you feel most comfortable and wake up least frequently during the night.
references: Sleep position matters when it comes to heart and brain health, so it is advisable to choose a position where you feel most comfortable and wake up least frequently during the night.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q64.explanationZh: “夜间醒来频率最低”= wake up least frequently during the night，副词 frequently 修饰 wake up；“关乎”用 matters when it comes to。

q65.sampleAnswer: Real friendship is more valuable than money.
references: Real friendship is more valuable than money.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q65.explanationZh: “友谊”friendship 作主语，“比……更宝贵”用比较级 more valuable than。

q66.sampleAnswer: This national gallery has a large collection of artworks from home and abroad, where people walk around leisurely, exploring the traces of time and feeling the integration of history and culture.
references: This national gallery has a large collection of artworks from home and abroad, where people walk around leisurely, exploring the traces of time and feeling the integration of history and culture.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q66.explanationZh: “艺术馆”用 gallery；“收藏了大量……”= has a large collection of；后半句用 where 引导定语从句，再用 exploring、feeling 表示伴随。

q67.sampleAnswer: Both difficulty and failure did not frustrate his passion.
references: Both difficulty and failure did not frustrate his passion.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q67.explanationZh: “挫伤”用 frustrate，did not 后接动词原形 frustrate；“热情”是 passion。

q68.sampleAnswer: Thanks to those who helped me, I managed to fulfill the task on time.
references: Thanks to those who helped me, I managed to fulfill the task on time.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q68.explanationZh: “多亏了”= thanks to；“得以完成”= managed to fulfill，fulfill a task“完成任务”。

q69.sampleAnswer: Facing new challenges, he is always full of confidence.
references: Facing new challenges, he is always full of confidence.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q69.explanationZh: “充满信心”= be full of confidence；“面对”用现在分词 Facing 开头。

q70.sampleAnswer: Don’t judge a person based on his appearance when making friends.
references: Don’t judge a person based on his appearance when making friends.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q70.explanationZh: “交友”= make friends，friends 用复数；“勿以貌取人”= don’t judge a person based on his appearance。

q71.sampleAnswer: Fueled by its rich farming culture and eco-tourism resources, this remote village has now transformed into a livable and tourist-friendly place.
references: Fueled by its rich farming culture and eco-tourism resources, this remote village has now transformed into a livable and tourist-friendly place.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q71.explanationZh: fuel 作动词“推动；激起”，“受……驱动”用过去分词 Fueled by 开头；“蜕变为”= has transformed into。

q72.sampleAnswer: For lack of construction funds, this commercial center wasn’t accessible to the public until recently.
references: For lack of construction funds, this commercial center wasn’t accessible to the public until recently.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q72.explanationZh: “因缺少”= for lack of，“建设资金”用复数 construction funds；“直到最近才”= not ... until recently。答案书印作 construction fund（单数），手册 fund 例句为 construction funds，经人工复核（GitHub #136）更正为复数 funds。

q73.sampleAnswer: The house is far from the shopping center, and furthermore, it is a bit too small.
references: The house is far from the shopping center, and furthermore, it is a bit too small.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q73.explanationZh: “此外”用副词 furthermore，前后用逗号隔开；“远离”= be far from。
